2608.24698.title: The Annotation Bottleneck in Persian Text NLP: Persian as an Annotation-Scarce Language
2608.24698.paper_summary: Persian (Farsi) is often described as a low-resource language in natural language processing, but that label collapses distinct shortages into a single category. This paper argues that Persian is more precisely described as annotation-scarce, provided that the term is understood as a property of its NLP resource ecology rather than an intrinsic property of the language. The review covers 34 representative Persian text resources available by July 2026 and adds three quantitative cross-checks. First, independent web measurements place Persian among roughly the twenty most visible content languages: W3Techs reports Persian on about 0.9% of websites with a known content language, while Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-30 identifies Persian as the primary language of 0.7039% of HTML pages. Second, a selective speech review shows a long resource trajectory from FARSDAT to recent corpora containing hundreds or thousands of hours of speech. Third, a matched Persian-English comparison normalizes task-specific annotation volumes by relative Common Crawl web presence. The resulting ratios vary sharply: Persian syntax and news NER are comparatively dense, whereas natural-language inference falls below the web-proportional baseline. The evidence therefore does not support a simple claim that Persian is globally deficient in labeled volume. Instead, annotation scarcity is expressed through uneven task and domain coverage, incompatible schemes, access and documentation friction, and limited supervision for specialist domains, preference data, and varieties beyond standard Iranian Persian.
2608.24698.paper_summary_zh: 波斯語（法爾西語）在自然語言處理中經常被描述為一種低資源語言，但這個標籤將不同的短缺歸納為一個單一類別。本文主張，波斯語更準確地被描述為註釋稀缺，前提是這一術語被理解為其自然語言處理資源生態的一個特性，而不是語言本身的內在特性。這篇回顧涵蓋了截至2026年7月可用的34個代表性波斯語文本資源，並增加了三項定量交叉檢查。首先，獨立的網絡測量將波斯語置於大約二十種最具可見性的內容語言之中：W3Techs報告波斯語在約0.9%的已知內容語言網站上，而Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-30則將波斯語識別為0.7039%的HTML頁面的主要語言。其次，選擇性的語音回顧顯示了從FARSDAT到最近包含數百或數千小時語音的語料庫的長期資源軌跡。第三，匹配的波斯語-英語比較通過相對的Common Crawl網絡存在來標準化特定任務的註釋量。由此產生的比率變化顯著：波斯語語法和新聞NER相對密集，而自然語言推理則低於網絡比例基準。因此，證據並不支持波斯語在標記量上全球不足的簡單說法。相反，註釋稀缺通過不均勻的任務和領域覆蓋、不相容的方案、訪問和文檔摩擦，以及對專業領域、偏好數據和超出標準伊朗波斯語的變體的有限監督來表達。
